description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller class named ManufacturerController, which manages CRUD operations for Manufacturer entities in an e-commerce admin interface. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting manufacturers, including validation and image processing.

classes.name: ManufacturerController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling manufacturer management in admin context, including list, create, edit, save, delete functions, with role-based authorization.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list manufacturers, sets menu, returns view.

methods.name: createManufacturer
methods.description: Handles GET to initiate creation of a new manufacturer, displays form.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Handles GET request to edit an existing manufacturer by ID, loads data into form.

methods.name: displayManufacturer
methods.description: Shared private method to prepare manufacturer data for create/edit views, including fetching existing manufacturer or initializing new, and setting descriptions for each language.

methods.name: saveManufacturer
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update manufacturer data, including validation, image processing, and persistence.

methods.name: pageManufacturers
methods.description: Handles POST request for paginated backend listing of manufacturers, returns JSON.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a manufacturer by ID, with checks for product associations.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility to set active menu context for views.
